retrieval: Official Commercial Legislation > Companies Regulations > Companies Regulations 2020 > View Current PDF; original downloaded through the browser.
implementation_scope: Explicit shared month-end policy only; no automatic ADGM authority applicability profile.
findings: Section 416 compares private/public ordinary periods, long first-period alternatives and shortened-period notice dates. Extensions and company status remain separate criteria.
Section 417(3) preserves a triggering month-end in the target month. Section 417(4) handles specified non-month-end dates falling into February.
A plain corresponding-day summary does not establish all month-end boundaries. The default generic calculation is preserved; a separately assessed rule may explicitly select the new policy.
limits: Only relevant account-filing sections are assessed here; this is not a complete review or qualification of 633 pages, all amendments, other company/LLP forms, accounts, audit or reporting laws.
The file-version date is not inferred commencement or entity applicability. Operative versions, event facts, business calendars and professional conclusions require independent assessment.
The guidance and primary regulation discuss extensions at different levels; no local calculation is treated as an ORS request, written notice, accepted submission or government receipt.
